# IFC Translations

This repository contains IFC translation files.

## Branches

* `input` - populated automatically from the IFC development repository. It contains the source translation files.
* `translations` - populated automatically from Crowdin. It contains the files translated to 30+ languages.

## Editing

**Do not edit** translation files manually in this repository. 

Changes must be made through the appropriate source:

* Source content changes belong in [the IFC development repository](https://github.com/buildingSMART/IFC4.x-development).
* Translation changes belong in [Crowdin](https://buildingsmart.crowdin.com/u/projects/2).

Manual edits may be overwritten by the automated synchronization process.

## Usage

The translated content from this repository is used to generate:

* IFC documentation
* [IFC content in the bSDD](https://identifier.buildingsmart.org/uri/buildingsmart/ifc/4.3) ([Read more about the bSDD](https://bsdd.buildingsmart.org/))
